name: demo-firearms
about: Hands-on demo, run in watch mode (2560x1440): a fresh level 20 Firearms Specialist in the lab town with 60 skill points, +100 to every attribute and 2x weapon attack speed (fire rate, gamelab/buffs_demo.sval), the Subclass Picker and the Skill Trainer (the lab town has none; skills are learned there) beside them, five training dummies in a row to the east (two normal, armored, magic, breakable), every firearms item on the ground (rifles, and two of each pistol tier: one pistol fits either hand) and cheats on. The whole setup is one typed command, gl setup gamelab/setup_demo_firearms.sval. Then the game stays open for four hours of play (an hour cut the user off mid-test, demo-firearms 20261019-170119). Not evidence of anything.
